d: Healed or marked by her mala; touched by a completed release.
Detected by the Damru signal; on a healer’s radar.
Ready to release; a wound at Stage 6. “Let it go, it’s ripe.”
Seen straight through — read past-present-future, wanted or not.
Passed Stage 4; the false story burned off. A compliment.
Formal-register slang for someone newly awakened — sight just opened.
